epics.title: Payment Gateway Integration
epics.description: Integration with a payment gateway (Stripe) for credit card payments, subscription management, and payment event handling

stories.title: As a customer, I want to make credit card payments, so that I can purchase products and services
stories.description: Integrate Stripe payment gateway for secure credit card transactions
acceptance_criteria: The system successfully processes a credit card payment and updates the order status
The system handles declined credit card payments and displays an error message to the customer

tasks.title: Implement Stripe payment gateway API integration
tasks.description: Set up Stripe API keys, configure payment gateway settings, and implement payment processing logic

tasks.title: Develop payment form with credit card input fields and validation
tasks.description: Create a secure payment form with input fields for credit card details, implement client-side validation, and handle form submission

tasks.title: Handle payment success and failure scenarios with error handling
tasks.description: Implement logic to handle payment success and failure scenarios, including error handling and logging

stories.title: As a customer, I want to manage my subscriptions, so that I can update or cancel my recurring payments
stories.description: Integrate Stripe subscription management for customers to manage their recurring payments
acceptance_criteria: The system allows customers to view and update their subscription details
The system successfully cancels a subscription and updates the customer's account status

tasks.title: Implement Stripe subscription management API integration
tasks.description: Set up Stripe subscription API endpoints, configure subscription settings, and implement subscription management logic

tasks.title: Develop subscription management UI with update and cancel options
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly subscription management interface with options to update or cancel subscriptions

tasks.title: Handle subscription updates and cancellations with webhook event handling
tasks.description: Implement logic to handle subscription updates and cancellations using Stripe webhooks, including event handling and logging

stories.title: As a system administrator, I want to receive payment event notifications, so that I can track and manage payment-related activities
stories.description: Integrate Stripe webhook handling for payment events and implement email notifications
acceptance_criteria: The system receives and processes Stripe webhook events for payment-related activities
The system sends email notifications to administrators for successful payments and payment-related events

tasks.title: Implement Stripe webhook handling for payment events
tasks.description: Set up Stripe webhook endpoints, configure event handling settings, and implement payment event processing logic

tasks.title: Develop email notification template for payment-related events
tasks.description: Create a customizable email notification template for payment-related events, including payment receipts and event details

tasks.title: Integrate email notification service with payment event handling
tasks.description: Implement logic to send email notifications to administrators for payment-related events, including payment receipts and event details

epics.title: User Authentication System
epics.description: A comprehensive system for user authentication, including login, signup, password reset, and OAuth integration

stories.title: As a user, I want to login to the system using email and password, so that I can access my account securely
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using their email and password, with proper validation and error handling
acceptance_criteria: The system validates user credentials correctly and allows access to the account when credentials are correct
The system displays an error message when the user enters incorrect credentials
The system locks the account after 3 failed login attempts

tasks.title: Implement email and password validation logic
tasks.description: Write backend code to validate user credentials and handle login requests

tasks.title: Create login page with email and password fields
tasks.description: Design and implement the login page with email and password input fields, and submit button

tasks.title: Integrate login functionality with account dashboard
tasks.description: Write code to redirect the user to their account dashboard after successful login

stories.title: As a new user, I want to signup for an account, so that I can use the system
stories.description: The system should allow new users to signup for an account, with proper validation and email verification
acceptance_criteria: The system validates user input data correctly and creates a new account when data is valid
The system sends a verification email to the user after signup
The system displays an error message when the user enters invalid data

tasks.title: Implement user input validation logic for signup
tasks.description: Write backend code to validate user input data and handle signup requests

tasks.title: Create signup page with user input fields
tasks.description: Design and implement the signup page with user input fields, and submit button

tasks.title: Integrate email verification functionality with signup
tasks.description: Write code to send a verification email to the user after signup and handle email verification

stories.title: As a user, I want to reset my password, so that I can recover my account
stories.description: The system should allow users to reset their password, with proper validation and email notification
acceptance_criteria: The system validates user input data correctly and sends a password reset email when data is valid
The system displays an error message when the user enters invalid data
The system allows the user to reset their password after receiving the password reset email

tasks.title: Implement password reset logic
tasks.description: Write backend code to handle password reset requests and send password reset emails

tasks.title: Create password reset page with user input fields
tasks.description: Design and implement the password reset page with user input fields, and submit button

tasks.title: Integrate password reset functionality with account settings
tasks.description: Write code to update the user's password after successful password reset

stories.title: As a user, I want to login using OAuth with Google and GitHub, so that I can access my account securely and easily
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using OAuth with Google and GitHub, with proper validation and account linking
acceptance_criteria: The system validates OAuth credentials correctly and allows access to the account when credentials are correct
The system displays an error message when the user's OAuth credentials are invalid
The system links the user's OAuth account to their system account after successful OAuth login

tasks.title: Implement OAuth login logic with Google
tasks.description: Write backend code to handle OAuth login requests with Google and validate user credentials

tasks.title: Implement OAuth login logic with GitHub
tasks.description: Write backend code to handle OAuth login requests with GitHub and validate user credentials

tasks.title: Integrate OAuth login functionality with account dashboard
tasks.description: Write code to redirect the user to their account dashboard after successful OAuth login

acceptance_criteria: The system sends a welcome email to users when they sign up for an account

acceptance_criteria: The system can be configured to use different email services (e.g. SendGrid, AWS SES)

epics.title: Admin Dashboard
epics.description: A dashboard for internal team to manage users, monitor the platform, and view analytics

stories.title: As an admin, I want to manage users, so that I can control access to the platform
stories.description: The admin dashboard should allow administrators to create, edit, and delete user accounts
acceptance_criteria: The admin can create a new user account with a unique username and password
The admin can edit an existing user's account information, including role and permissions
The admin can delete a user account and all associated data
The system prevents duplicate usernames and invalid password formats

tasks.title: Design and implement user management database schema
tasks.description: Create a database schema to store user account information

tasks.title: Develop user management UI components
tasks.description: Create UI components for creating, editing, and deleting user accounts

tasks.title: Implement user management business logic and validation
tasks.description: Write code to handle user account creation, editing, and deletion, including validation and error handling

stories.title: As an admin, I want to view analytics dashboards, so that I can monitor platform performance
stories.description: The admin dashboard should display key metrics and analytics about platform usage and performance
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays the number of active users in real-time
The dashboard displays revenue metrics, including total revenue and revenue growth
The dashboard displays system performance metrics, including response time and error rate
The dashboard allows admins to filter and drill down into specific metrics and time ranges

tasks.title: Design and implement analytics data pipeline
tasks.description: Create a data pipeline to collect and process analytics data from the platform

tasks.title: Develop analytics dashboard UI components
tasks.description: Create UI components to display analytics metrics and charts

tasks.title: Implement analytics data visualization and filtering
tasks.description: Write code to display and filter analytics data, including charts and tables

stories.title: As an admin, I want to monitor system health, so that I can identify and resolve issues
stories.description: The admin dashboard should display system health metrics and alerts
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays system health metrics, including CPU usage and memory usage
The dashboard displays error logs and alerts for system issues
The dashboard allows admins to configure alert thresholds and notification settings
The dashboard displays a system health score or status indicator

tasks.title: Design and implement system health monitoring API
tasks.description: Create an API to collect and expose system health metrics

tasks.title: Develop system health dashboard UI components
tasks.description: Create UI components to display system health metrics and alerts

tasks.title: Implement system health alerting and notification logic
tasks.description: Write code to handle system health alerts and notifications, including threshold configuration

stories.title: As an admin, I want to configure platform settings, so that I can customize the platform
stories.description: The admin dashboard should allow administrators to configure platform settings and preferences
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard allows admins to configure platform-wide settings, including timezone and currency
The dashboard allows admins to manage platform integrations and APIs
The dashboard displays a list of available configuration options and their current values
The dashboard prevents admins from saving invalid or conflicting configuration settings

tasks.title: Design and implement configuration management database schema
tasks.description: Create a database schema to store platform configuration settings

tasks.title: Develop configuration management UI components
tasks.description: Create UI components to display and edit platform configuration settings

tasks.title: Implement configuration management business logic and validation
tasks.description: Write code to handle configuration setting updates, including validation and error handling

stories.title: As an admin, I want to view real-time metrics, so that I can monitor platform activity
stories.description: The admin dashboard should display real-time metrics about platform activity and usage
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays real-time metrics, including active users and requests per second
The dashboard displays a real-time activity feed, including user actions and system events
The dashboard allows admins to filter and drill down into specific metrics and time ranges
The dashboard updates metrics and activity feed in real-time, with minimal latency

tasks.title: Design and implement real-time metrics API
tasks.description: Create an API to collect and expose real-time metrics

tasks.title: Develop real-time metrics dashboard UI components
tasks.description: Create UI components to display real-time metrics and activity feed

tasks.title: Implement real-time metrics updating and filtering logic
tasks.description: Write code to update and filter real-time metrics, including handling latency and data consistency
